summary: Yamalo-Nenets Autonomous Okrug stands under the national framework of the Russian Federation. No law, ordinance, enforcement practice, regional institution or documented incident specific to the okrug and bearing on transgender visitors appears in the sources reviewed; the national assessment governs what a visitor faces in this federal subject.
tangentialFactors: The two documents available for this jurisdiction — the UK Home Office country policy and information note on sexual orientation and gender identity and expression (June 2025) and Human Rights Watch reporting of 30 June 2025 — both assess the Russian Federation as a whole. Neither offers a comparison, contrast or adjacent factor drawn from Yamalo-Nenets specifically.
localsOnly: No measure directed at residents of Yamalo-Nenets Autonomous Okrug as distinct from the rest of the Russian Federation was identified: no okrug-level administrative instruction, regional decree or regional enforcement record on gender identity is documented in the source set. Trans residents of the okrug are subject to the same national provisions as residents elsewhere in the country.
outOfScopeNotes: Both sources in the inventory are national in scope and neither records a regional deviation for the okrug. Whether Yamalo-Nenets authorities enforce the national statutes on gender identity and on public expression more or less intensively than authorities in other federal subjects is unresolved and not sourced.
